user_reported_bug: Clarice ainda está na lista dos clientes que seriam bloqueados na produção — usuário não está confiante no auto-bloqueio
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused backend verification showed the new Asaas source-of-truth path does protect a locally overdue customer when Asaas has a recent RECEIVED payment, and Clarice is absent from /simular. However, the implementation also treats old Asaas payments outside the 60-day window as paid because it returns True when any RECEIVED payment exists without a usable/recent date check; an Asaas customer whose latest payment was 2026-05-24 (cutoff 2026-05-25) was incorrectly omitted from /simular.

critical.issue: Asaas old-only paid customer was incorrectly considered em dia and omitted from the simulation. Code path lines 347-350 in _cliente_ja_pagou_no_mes returns True for any non-empty RECEIVED/CONFIRMED Asaas payment list even when parsed paymentDate/confirmedDate/clientPaymentDate is older than 60 days.
Diagnostic endpoint also reports old-only Asaas payment customers as seria_bloqueado=false, making audit output misleading for genuinely delinquent customers with old payment history.

action_items: Remove or tighten the fallback at _cliente_ja_pagou_no_mes lines 347-350 so only RECEIVED/CONFIRMED Asaas payments with paymentDate/confirmedDate/clientPaymentDate within the last 60 days return True.
Add a regression test for an Asaas customer with only payments older than 60 days; it should still appear in /simular when local cobrança is overdue and unpaid.
critical_code_review_comments: The new Asaas condition works for recent payments, but violates the stated 60-day contract by returning True for any non-empty payment list after date parsing fails to find a recent date. This can hide genuinely delinquent customers from the block simulation.
seed_data_creation: Created seven tagged BUG33 MongoDB-only clients/cobrancas/linhas: Asaas recent-only, Asaas old-only, local same-month paid, local future paid, local paid_at 50 days, true delinquent, and whitelist. Used real Asaas read-only list_payments calls to select existing production customer IDs. Cleanup verified 0 remaining BUG33 tagged records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Skill search 'Clarice clientes bloqueados produção simular bloqueio Asaas' returned no relevant testing skill. Backend was running and Asaas production config loaded. Clarice id 69d023bc83caf2c1f9c09efe was absent and /diagnosticar said seria_bloqueado=false. No MOCKED APIs were used; direct helper used local fakes only for isolated code-path verification.
rca_of_the_issue: Regression RCA: condition 4 correctly calls Asaas.list_payments(customer_id, status=RECEIVED/CONFIRMED), but after checking parsed dates against the 60-day cutoff it has a fallback that returns True for any non-empty payments list. Because list_payments returns historical payments too, old paid customers can be treated as current even when no payment exists in the last 60 days.
